actualNote: Other work bounded ridge-end stack placement trial. Andreas/Braunhold's public-domain 1884 retrospective plate draws the two ridge stacks near the gable ends; the current comparison has them farther inward at the generic frontage fractions 0.22/0.78. Select the existing gable ends kit instead. Its 0.60 m end inset, 0.90 m square shafts and ridge + 0.55 m tops are reconstructed generator choices, not dimensions measured from the engraving. The source supports relative disposition only; it supplies no coordinate, July 1835 fitting date, historical camera or independent metric calibration. Count 2, brick finish, shaft section/top, main roof/cornice/wing, openings, position and the separate Carpenter shop remain selected as before. The retained diagnostic-camera projection suggests improved horizontal placement but leaves vertical/roof and broader compound differences unresolved; no rendered acceptance or full image match is claimed by this data trial. the liberties register “The Sauganash stacks move toward the ridge ends”.
